data.name: Sosanna
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Sosanna means 'saved' or 'delivered'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'yesa', which means 'to save'. In the Bible, Sosanna is the name of a woman who was saved from death by the prophet Daniel.

in_hebrew.name: סוסנה
in_hebrew.meaning: היא שושנה, פרח הלוטוס, שושנת הוורד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם סוסנה הוא עברי ומקורו בפרח השושנה, שמסמל טוהר, יופי וחדווה. השושנה מוזכרת בספרים שונים של התנך, ומהווה סמל לתחייה ולחיים חדשים. השם סוסנה הוא גם אחד השמות הנקשרים לאחת הנשים שהופיעו בביבליה, והוא נושא עמו משמעות של יופי ושלמות.

in_greek.name: Σοσάννα
in_greek.meaning: Σοσάννα, το κρίνον, το λουλούδι της χαράς
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σοσάννα είναι ελληνικό και προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'שושנה' (shoshanah), που σημαίνει κρίνος ή λουλούδι. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Σοσάννα αναφέρεται σε μια γυναίκα που ήταν μαθήτρια του Ιησού. Το όνομα Σοσάννα συμβολίζει την αγνότητα, την ομορφιά και τη χαρά.

in_latin.name: Sosanna
in_latin.meaning: Sosanna, flos lilii, significat gaudium et pulchritudo
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Sosanna origine hebraicum est et lilium seu florem designat. In traditione christiana, Sosanna est nomen femininum quod gaudium, pulchritudinem et innocentiam significat. Nomen hoc in scripturis sacris non invenitur, sed est usitatum in liturgia et traditione ecclesiastica.

in_english.name: Sosanna
in_english.meaning: Lily or rose, symbolizing purity, beauty, and joy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sosanna originates from the Hebrew word 'shoshanah,' meaning lily or rose. It symbolizes purity, beauty, and joy. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name Sosanna is associated with Christian tradition and represents innocence, charm, and spiritual growth. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its timeless appeal and significance.

It is a powerful reminder of the salvific work of God, evocative of His goodness and love that extends to saving His people from harm. The name has been popular in Christian communities due to its association with hope, deliverance, and the power of God's grace.

It is a reminder that no matter the circumstances, God is always with us and that He has the power to save us from the trials and tribulations of life. The name Sosanna is a call to trust in God's providence and to find refuge in His love and mercy. Ultimately, it is a testament to the power of God to save and deliver His people.
